title: TempBanned for Combat Logging

replies.author: hcnem
replies.body:
Hey jammyjar42,

Combat logging is when you exit the game to avoid a death while in PvP. However, since your ban is already expired, this appeal will be considered "dealt with." For future reference, please refer to the rules (http://avicus.net/rules) before committing an action.
 
Regards,
PeachyYas | Senior Moderator
